title: Where You End
voice_standard: Liam - warm brilliant friend at midnight; sly on the party-trick turn, tender and low on the grief beat, expansive on the freedom, lands gentle on the invitation; one ruling metaphor (the negotiable edge / the tide)

scenes.text: Quick question. Where do you end?
scenes.semantic_anchor: A hand at the edge of lamplight, the rest in shadow.
scenes.query: hand edge of light dark table close

scenes.text: Obvious — at your skin. That's the wall. Inside is you, outside is world.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A wall — the supposed hard border between self and world.
scenes.query: old brick wall edge shadow dividing line

scenes.text: Cute. Let me talk your brain out of it in ninety seconds.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A stopwatch beside a soft paintbrush — the experiment begins.
scenes.query: vintage stopwatch gears ticking macro dark

scenes.text: There's a famous trick: a rubber hand where yours would be, your real hand hidden.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A lifelike rubber hand resting on a table beside a hidden real one.
scenes.query: rubber prosthetic hand on table dim

scenes.text: Then someone strokes both — the fake you see, the real you don't — in perfect time.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A brush stroking a hand in rhythm, synchrony made visible.
scenes.query: paintbrush stroking hand slow motion close

scenes.text: Within a minute it breaks. You flinch when the rubber hand is threatened. Your brain has moved in.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The rubber hand glowing faintly as if newly claimed, warm light spreading into it.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a lifelike rubber hand on a dark wooden table with a faint warm golden glow spreading into it from the wrist as if being adopted as living, a real human hand out of focus in shadow in the near foreground, one clinical desk lamp as the only light, shallow depth of field, film grain, photoreal magical realism, no text, no words

scenes.text: So your body's edge isn't a fact. It's a guess — a live inference your brain updates from evidence.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A boundary line — half-erased, being redrawn.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a white chalk boundary line drawn across dark slate floor, one end dissolving into drifting chalk dust while the other end is being freshly extended by an unseen force, cold blue side light, out-of-focus chalk stub in the near foreground, macro depth of field, film grain, photoreal, no text, no words

scenes.text: And if the edge can move OUT, watch how far it travels.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A ripple spreading outward on dark water.
scenes.query: water ripple spreading dark surface slow

scenes.text: And if the edge can move outward — watch how far it travels.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A cane meeting pavement, the point of contact glowing.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a white cane tip touching wet cobblestone pavement at night, a soft golden glow at the exact point of contact as if sensation lives there, blurred street lamps deep in the background, out-of-focus railing in the near foreground, film grain, photoreal magical realism, no text, no words

scenes.text: A blind man's cane isn't a stick he holds. He feels the pavement at its tip. His skin ends at the ground.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A hand on a wheel, the car's edges faintly lit like limbs.
scenes.query: hands steering wheel car night dashboard

scenes.text: A driver doesn't calculate the car's corners — she feels them. The metal became her body. That's why the scratch makes you wince.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Fingers moving over keys without looking, fluent.
scenes.query: keyboard keys pressed motion blur macro

scenes.text: Now the part that isn't a party trick.
scenes.semantic_anchor: The lamp dims; a breath before something true.
scenes.query: dim lamp glow dark quiet room

scenes.text: The people you love are inside the line too. Your brain drew them in, stroke by stroke, until they were load-bearing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Two silhouettes woven together by threads of warm light.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, two human silhouettes sitting close in warm lamplight with fine threads of soft gold light connecting them at the shoulders and hands as if woven into one boundary, deep shadow around, out-of-focus doorframe in the near foreground, film grain, photoreal magical realism, tender, no text, no words

scenes.text: Which is why grief lands in the body. Not sadness about someone out there — an amputation of a part that was in here.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A body-map with one region gone dark, like a limb missing.
scenes.image_prompt: cinematic 35mm film still, a glowing anatomical map of a human figure made of warm constellation light against black, one region near the chest gone dark and cold as if a piece has been removed, faint dust motes, cinematic, film grain, photoreal, no readable text, abstract glowing marks only

scenes.text: So the self was never a fortress with a fixed wall. It's a tide — going out to meet what it touches, pulling some of it back in.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A tide reaching up a dark shore and drawing back, taking some sand.
scenes.query: ocean tide shore pulling back dark sand

scenes.text: And here's the freedom in it. If the edge is negotiable, you get a say in the negotiation.
scenes.semantic_anchor: An open hand, palm up, ready to include.
scenes.query: open hand palm up warm light

scenes.text: And the freedom in it: if the edge is negotiable, you get a say in the negotiation.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Warm light spilling across an open landscape at dawn.
scenes.query: warm dawn light open landscape wide

scenes.text: You can widen the line — to the work you pour into, the place that raised you, the stranger you decide to feel.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A lone figure behind glass, the world kept outside.
scenes.query: silhouette behind window rain alone night

scenes.text: Or pull it so tight nothing gets to be part of you. That's called a wall. It's also called lonely.
scenes.semantic_anchor: Hands wrapped around a warm cup in soft morning light.
scenes.query: warm cup steam rising morning light table

scenes.text: Feel where you supposedly stop. Then ask the honest question:
scenes.semantic_anchor: The fingertip meeting the cup, the exact seam.
scenes.query: ceramic cup rim water droplet macro warm

scenes.text: What have you been calling 'not me'… that you can't find the seam of? Go find your edge tonight. You might be bigger than you were told.
scenes.semantic_anchor: A small figure against a vast warm horizon — edges uncertain, and glad of it.
scenes.query: person silhouette vast horizon warm dusk
